text:
maya: Quick brainstorm / benchmark launch assets: want a short post, 2-panel chart (latency vs $) and a gated token-cost calculator. audience: devs + platform buyers.
sam: Chart idea: left panel = $ per 1k tokens across models/configs; right = p95 latency vs $ per 1k reqs. Simple labels: '$ / 1k tokens'.
toni: Design notes: call out batching + KV-cache knee, dashed lines for fallback model, inset for streaming latency of short prompts. Use brand blues and one accent color.
lee: Inbound routing plan: signup asks 'monthly tokens' -> buckets: <50k self-serve, 50k-500k nurture, >500k SDR. Tag leads 'bench_interest'. Route >200k to SDR.
maya: Copy hooks: headline 'From latency to dollars: benchmark what matters.' Social: 'See how batching, caching & quantization change your token bill.'
sam: I'll prep numbers and kneepoint. Captions: 'Unit costs fall with throughput; quantization shifts the curve down' and 'Lower p95 typically increases unit cost  pick the SLO'.
benchbot: bench export: https://internal.benchmarks.redwood/175602 file: bench-econ-v4.csv (batching on/off, quantization variants).
toni: I'll mock PNGs 1200x630 for social and slides. Make text legible at thumbnail size.
lee: Webinar 10-15m: 1) problem, 2) demo of dashboard + calculator, 3) playbook (routing + rollout). CTA: 'Calculate your token economics' -> gated sheet + API sample.
maya: Gated sheet = spreadsheet with formulas + sample CSV import. Provide one-click curl to compute estimate on free credits.
sam: Sample curl: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/calc -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"rwd-13b-q4","tokens":1000,"batch":8,"quant":"q4_0"}'
toni: Microcopy: 'Estimates assume steady-state throughput; spikes change p95'.
lee: Marketing will add hidden field 'tokens_estimate' and set owner via zap->CRM. Ops confirm tag names.
maya: Timeline: numbers + visuals by Tue, copy Wed, page + gated sheet Fri, webinar next Wed. Owners: sam numbers, toni visuals, lee routing, maya copy.
sam: I'll post raw CSV Tue AM.
toni: Figma links when mocks ready.
lee: Will test form + routing on staging Thu.
maya: Final review Tue afternoon. Small asks: sam include batch sizes and cache on/off, toni export PNG 1200x630 and slide PNG, lee confirm CRM tags. :tada:
